Prune ghost divides (areas below a threshold)

Source: R/repairs.R
prune_ghost_divides.Rd

Removes network divides whose areasqkm is below a threshold. These are usually produced by imbalanced PRD watershed splits where two sibling reconciled flowlines share a parent reference COMID and one side receives essentially no area (often <500 m2). The corresponding aggregated flowpath is a through-reach with no meaningful local drainage; keeping a microscopic "ghost" polygon makes the visualization misleading and the schema inconsistent (has_divide = TRUE with a 100 m2 polygon).

For each ghost divide: the divide row is dropped and its flowpath is updated with has_divide = FALSE, divide_id = NA, areasqkm = 0. A subsequent hfutils::clean_gpkg_layer(..., gap_fill_area = > threshold) call will absorb the resulting tiny gaps into neighbor divides.

Usage

prune_ghost_divides(
  input_gpkg,
  threshold_sqkm = 0.001,
  divide_layer = "divides",
  flowpath_layer = "flowpaths"
)

Arguments

input_gpkg

Path to the GeoPackage (must contain divides and flowpaths layers).

threshold_sqkm

Divides with areasqkm strictly less than this are pruned. Default 0.001 (1000 m2).

divide_layer

Name of the divides layer. Default "divides".

flowpath_layer

Name of the flowpaths layer. Default "flowpaths".

Value

Invisibly, a list of pruned divide_id values.
